prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Below are several specific personal-injury law firms you should call in Houston after a car wreck, and why each is worth contacting. I also include what to ask them on the call and next steps so you know how to compare them.

Top firms to call (and why)

- Arnold & Itkin LLP (Houston)
  - Why: Houston-based plaintiffs’ trial firm with a strong track record in catastrophic-accident cases and large jury verdicts/settlements. Good if your case involves severe injury, wrongful death, or complex liability.
- The Lanier Law Firm (Houston)
  - Why: Nationally known plaintiff firm headquartered in Houston. Reputation for high-value settlements and trial readiness, with large resources for complex cases.
- Morgan & Morgan (Houston)
  - Why: Large national plaintiffs’ firm with a Houston presence. Broad experience, lots of resources (investigators, medical-network), and typically a strong local intake team for injury claims.
- The Barnes Firm (Houston office)
  - Why: National personal-injury firm with a focus on car wrecks, prompt client intake, and experience negotiating with major insurers. Good if you want an aggressive negotiator who handles many auto cases.
- The Cochran Firm (Houston)
  - Why: National firm with a long history in personal injury/ civil-rights work. Known for advocacy in serious injury cases and community reputation.
- Hawkins Parnell & Young (Houston)
  - Why: Plaintiffs’ litigation firm with experience in product liability and big-injury litigation; good if your crash involves defective parts, trucks, or complex multi-party liability.

(If you want smaller local boutiques or a board-certified personal injury trial lawyer, I can compile a list targeted to a specific neighborhood/ZIP or for a specific injury type.)

What to ask on the first call (quick script)
- “Do you handle car-accident cases in Houston, and how long have you handled cases like mine (describe injuries and severity)?”
- “Do you take cases on contingency? What is your fee and any other costs I’d be responsible for?”
- “Who on the team will be my main contact, and how often will I get updates?”
- “Have you taken similar cases to trial or gotten large settlements? Can you give a recent example?”
- “Will you refer me to medical providers and handle medical liens?”
- “What is your estimate of next steps and timeline?”
- “Are there any statute-of-limitations or deadline issues I should know about?” (In Texas normally 2 years from the crash for personal injury — call quickly.)

What to have ready before you call
- Date, time, and location of the crash
- Names/plate numbers/insurers if you have them
- Police report number (if available)
- Brief summary of injuries and current medical status
- Any settlement offers from insurance
- Photos, videos, or witness contact info (if you have them)

How to compare firms
- Trial experience and verdicts for similar cases
- Resources (investigators, medical network)
- Communication style and who you’ll deal with
- Fee structure and expected out-of-pocket costs
- Client reviews and local reputation
- Whether they will accept your case on a contingency basis and advance costs

Next steps I can do for you
- Look up firm phone numbers and office addresses in Houston and send them to you
- Narrow the list to firms that handle your exact injury (e.g., traumatic brain injury, spinal, wrongful death, truck crash)
- Draft a short script you can read on calls or an email template to send for intake

If you want, tell me:
- ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston
- How badly you were injured and whether the other driver’s insurer has contacted you
- Whether you already spoke to any firm

I’ll then pull phone numbers and prioritize firms best matched to your facts.
